translations./garage/brief: Travel from the signal tower back to the calibration pad across the full depot. There are no forklifts; this run tests pacing and patience.
translations./prediction/hint: Make a prediction: will a steady pace or repeated sprints reach the calibration pad first?
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: Repeated full-throttle bursts can lose both time and energy. Compare the clock with the energy meter.
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: Enter a corner too late and RO-1 must take a wide arc. Inspect the path through each bend.
translations./running/normal_line: RO-1: Long-haul cruise stable. Holding pace.
translations./debrief/success_summary: Across the depot, steady speed arrives sooner and gentle control saves energy.
translations./debrief/failure_summary: Find which badge was lost. A long haul punishes uneven pacing.
translations./debrief/evidence_caption: Safety, speed, and efficiency are scored separately from this simulation run.
